Wb.bar_b_note: A's ember-seamed plated boar has a clear identity and silhouette, but on both sides the faint-mid pose lifts the body off its shadow and the faint-end body goes almost black, and B's all-dark-brown plates merge into one mass at small size, so neither is quite at the owner's creature finish yet.

Ma.bar_b_note: The trunks, purple sky gaps, rain and glowing mushrooms give it mood, but a flat brown mud path fills the lower half of every frame, all six views show only the calm phase, and the fallen giant shows up only in B v02/v03 as a dark red-brown tangle, so it lacks Valheim-class light and a hero landmark.

Ps.bar_b_note: The purple storm sky and the white-violet lightning in the break phase land well, but a small generic cottage sits on a uniform dark grass plain that runs to an empty horizon, beside an unexplained black lattice tower, with puffy sprite fog in the fading phase, so the world reads thin rather than lived-in.

Im.bar_b_note: A's plank lining, hearth fire and storm-lit window give a believable Stormwood shelter, but the window is a blown-out violet slab standing off the wall; B is one flat orange wash under a cream plaster gable, has no window and looks the same in all four phases, and both rooms are sparsely dressed.

Oz.bar_b_note: B's larger wrapped recipe text and bold ingredient lines fix legibility on the on-direction blue-grey panel, but the Craft and Leave hints are still small grey glyphs with no teal or gold accent, and A's tiny ellipsised rows and hint text would not read on a 7-inch screen.

Tc.bar_b_note: These frames match Ps: the storm sky and lightning are convincing, but a flat uniform grass plain, an empty horizon, a generic small cottage, a black lattice tower that does not read and blob-sprite fog keep it from Palworld density or Valheim-class atmosphere.

Xr.bar_b_note: A's braced timber frame, plank cap and separate stone footing make a credible built piece, but it is still a lone thin panel in an empty field next to a faceted flat-grey boulder; B is a blown-out white card with no cap or footing.

Rg.bar_b_note: The white-haired elder has a clean stylised face with readable eyes, a strong hair-and-beard silhouette and an earthy olive-and-brown outfit that fits the Meadows palette at Palworld-class finish; only the stiff full-body stance holds it back.

top_changes.change: Break the uniform Stormwood ground carpet (Ma mud path, Ps/Tc grass plain) with soil, moss and rock transitions, roots, black pools and copper/glass accents, and group vegetation into groves and clearings with a layered distant treeline instead of an empty horizon.
Build a hero fallen-giant landmark mesh for the Deepwood that shows in every production camera, and replace or explain the black lattice tower in Ma/Ps/Tc.

Make storm phases read: grade sky, light and fog per phase (Ma shows only calm, Im B is identical across phases), keep A's storm-lit window inside the shelter but tame its blown-out glow, and carry A-style cap, footing and thickness onto the homestead wall.
